metadata.title: Age-aware HbA1c reliability across NHANES cycles: reproducibility materials
metadata.description: Reproducibility materials for the study Age-Aware Reliability of HbA1c Prediction Across NHANES Cycles: Leakage-Free Evaluation, Conformal Calibration, and Temporal Transport. Primary global residual and age-Mondrian analyses, secondary recovered original CQR, exploratory later fixed-configuration CQR, and historical ANFIS materials must retain their separate evidence roles.
